lines.3: The test range was wider than I'd expected, so I'd started studying in a panic... but this one looked rough.
lines.8: 「When someone talks to you, you stop. That's sound logic, right?」
lines.11: 「Yeah. The test range is huge. It's killing me.」
lines.12: 「Hah. That's what happens when you never review normally.」
lines.13: 「It's because I was helping the drama club.」
lines.15: 「Man, I wish somebody would help me.」
lines.18: Konoe had started thinking about something, so I left her to it.
